title: Who is a research analyst and who must register
objectives: Define a research analyst and a research report under the SEBI regulations.
Say who must be registered and who is exempt.
body_md:
A **research analyst (RA)** is a person who prepares or publishes a research report, gives a recommendation or target price on a security, or does so in a public appearance. A **research report** is any written or electronic analysis of securities that includes a recommendation, rating or target price.

## Who must register

| Case | Registration needed? |
|---|---|
| Individual or firm publishing recommendations to clients | Yes, with SEBI |
| Employee of a registered RA entity, writing under it | Covered by the entity, but needs the prescribed qualification |
| Media or public appearance giving buy/sell views | Yes, unless an exemption applies |
| Broker research for own clients, as a registered intermediary | Covered by the intermediary's own regime, with RA rules on report content |

## Why it matters

- Unregistered recommendations are a violation, however informal the channel (WhatsApp, Telegram, YouTube).
- Registration brings a code of conduct, record keeping and disclosure duties.

> **Exam tip:** NISM-Series-XV tests definitions. Learn "research report", "research analyst", "associate" and "research entity".
example: A YouTuber says 'buy this stock, target ₹900' to 50,000 followers. That is a recommendation with a target price in a public appearance. Without registration it is a violation.
say: I am registered with SEBI; my registration number is on every report.
This is research, not a guarantee of returns.
never: I am not registered, but my tips are free so it is fine.
Everyone in the group chat knows it is only my opinion.

check.q: A recommendation with a target price on a stock, given to the public, is:
o: Research that needs a registered RA
Only a tip if it is free
check.why: Recommendations and target prices fall under the RA regulations whatever the channel.

check.q: A research report is best described as:
o: Analysis of securities with a recommendation, rating or target price
check.why: The defining feature is the recommendation, rating or target price.

check.q: Giving paid buy/sell calls on Telegram without registration is:
o: Acceptable if disclosed in the group
A violation of the RA regulations
check.why: Channel and group size do not remove the need for registration.
